The existing standard requires a complete named body plus an independent natural original-address caller/ABI witness, not adoption of that replay as native C++ source. The 204-byte representation-equivalent C-linkage replay retains the actual named call and has zero rewrites. It supplies bounded ABI/name evidence; it does not approve nominal C++ wchar_t equivalence or replace the accepted unsigned-short interface. Public-header C++ refusal and C mismatches remain failures.

Full 18-byte relocation-free vendor equality plus this independent anchor meets the unchanged standard. No historical archive uniqueness or C source credit follows.
